Data Retention Policy




Internal Wiki > Policies > Data Retention


Data Retention Policy


Customer Document Storage


Uploaded customer documents are retained for the lifetime of the customer's
active subscription. Upon subscription cancellation, documents and their
associated embeddings are deleted within 30 days, and this deletion is
irreversible after it completes.


Query Logs


Query logs, including the question text and returned citations, are
retained for 180 days for debugging and quality-evaluation purposes. Query
logs are anonymized after 30 days by stripping any customer-identifying
metadata, but the question text itself is not redacted.


Embeddings Cache


Embeddings are cached indefinitely for deduplication purposes, keyed by a
hash of the source text rather than the source document, so a cached
embedding is not itself tied to a specific customer after the source
document is deleted.


Last updated by the platform team
